limitations: Checks are based on tracked file path, blob SHA and size, not full semantic inspection of every underlying file.
Git blob SHA-1 identifies public tracked content, not its license, safe reuse, confidentiality or original private run.
Do not delete, rewrite or untrack files automatically; source-preserving decisions need user/rights-holder authorization.
Some raw answers and prompts already present in the public repository are not considered safe merely because they are public.
